messages.content: I want to start posting content but I'm scared of judgment from people I know.
That fear is common and pretty rational — real people you know seeing it is genuinely different from strangers online. Is it specific people you're worried about, or judgment in general?
Mostly my family honestly, they're pretty conservative.

That changes the calculation a lot. A pseudonym and keeping your face out of content, at least initially, protects you from that specific risk while you figure out if this is even something you want to continue.
Would that actually work though, people find stuff eventually.

It's risk reduction, not risk elimination, honestly - nothing online is fully anonymous forever. But combined with basic precautions (no location tags, no identifiable background details, separate accounts), it meaningfully lowers the odds compared to doing nothing.
